integrity: The claim has a self-contained analytic proof from the edge-opposite-vertex triangle decomposition and exact chord distance. Finite numerical overlay checks are sanity checks only and are not used to infer the all-n statement. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to regular Euclidean polygons with odd n>=5. The exact area probabilities of intermediate multiplicities 1,3,...,n-2 are not computed; no claim is made for irregular or even polygons or higher dimensions. The almost-everywhere statement excludes a finite union of line segments. Historical novelty retains unindexed-literature risk.
title: Maximal affine-diameter multiplicity locus in regular odd polygons
